title: Fine-Tuning Small Language Models for Reliable VASP INCAR Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.05387v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models can prepare VASP INCAR files from natural-language requests, but so far only large proprietary cloud models come close to handling the tightly coupled, physics-sensitive settings reliably, a dependence that fits poorly with local, high-throughput materials workflows where privacy, cost, and offline deployment matter. We show that a small language model (SLM) can close this gap. The SLM is fine-tuned on reference VASP calculations and paired with VASPGuard, a deterministic post-processor that checks syntax, workflow, and material-dependent constraints; we call the combined model INCAR-SLM. On INCARBench, a benchmark for VASP INCAR generation, INCAR-SLM built on Qwen3-4B outperforms every general-purpose LLM evaluated, exceeding GPT-5.4 by 15.55 points on the 100-point INCAR Score. translated_title: 微调小型语言模型以实现可靠的VASP INCAR文件生成
translated_abstract: 语言模型可以根据自然语言请求生成VASP INCAR文件，但迄今为止只有大型专有云端模型才能较为可靠地处理这些紧密耦合、对物理敏感的参数设置，而这种依赖关系与本地高通量材料计算工作流程的需求很不匹配——后者对隐私、成本和离线部署都有较高要求。我们证明小型语言模型（SLM）可以弥合这一差距。该SLM在参考VASP计算数据上进行了微调，并与VASPGuard配对使用——后者是一个用于检查语法、工作流程和材料相关约束的确定性后处理器；我们将这一组合模型称为INCAR-SLM。在VASP INCAR生成基准测试INCARBench上，基于Qwen3-4B构建的INCAR-SLM优于所有被评估的通用大语言模型，在100分制的INCAR评分上超过GPT-5.4达15.55分。这一提升大部分来自微调，而VASPGuard则纠正了剩余的错误。我们进一步发现，模型大小的重要性低于……
tldr: 通过微调4B参数的小型语言模型并结合确定性后处理器VASPGuard，INCAR-SLM在VASP INCAR生成基准上超越GPT-5.4等通用大模型15.55分，实现了本地部署、隐私安全且可靠的材料计算输入文件自动生成。
